core_reference: Carhart (1997 JoF 52:1) momentum premium + Blitz-Huij-Martens (2011 JPM 37:2) risk-managed residual momentum + Fama-French (1992) cross-sectional factor research + L-148 (C1-C15 수동 검증) + L-159 (spec transmission failure pattern) + Scout DIAG_STR_1684_H_1688_residualization.json (hypothesis B 85% probability)
lesson_text: H_1688 Residual Momentum Carhart 1997 + Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011 정통 설계 구현에도 Grade F (MDD 86.66 / SR -0.13 / CAGR -4.32 / stress 0/3) 확정. Pre-hurdle 'KR momentum inverse' 가설은 Scout DIAG evidence로 REJECTED (10% probability). Scout hypothesis B '구현 버그' 85% probability 채택. 3종 empirical evidence: (1) Factor DB parquet Z_Score sd가 factor별 극단 불일치 — M07 1.000 정상 / R12_Idiosyncratic_Risk 0.071 / D01_IdioVol 0.071 / M08_Residual_Mom 0.054 severe distortion. proper Z-score sd=1.0 기준 불충족 — factor_db_builder pipeline 차원의 clipping/scale 왜곡. (2) **R12 vs D01 duplicate**: 두 factor Z_Score 완전 동일 (sd 0.07063515 identical, n=2543). Registry 명시에도 actual data identical — mis-labeled or alias. Factor DB serious issue. (3) OLS 회귀 `lm(m01_w ~ size_w + r12_w + beta_w)`에서 regressor sd 불균형 (M01 0.66 / size 1.0 / R12 0.07 / beta unknown) — size_w 단독 지배 잔차화 → residual ≈ M01 - β·size (signed-flip M01 근접). 실측 ICIR -0.187이 M01 original positive ICIR approximate negation과 일치. L-159 (STR_1682 spec transmission) pattern의 **Factor DB layer 버전**. 둘 다 hypothesis 자체가 아닌 infrastructure/implementation 실패. H_1688 hypothesis **UNVALIDATED** 상태 — redesign path open. 교훈: (a) Factor DB Z_Score 사용 전 sd=1.0 확인 preflight 의무, (b) OLS 회귀 전 scale() 정규화 표준화 (lm 전 all regressors pre-standardize), (c) factor registry duplicate check 자동화 (R12/D01 같은 alias 검출), (d) Factor DB builder Z-score 재정규화 pipeline 재점검 (factor_db_builder.R), (e) UNVALIDATED_HARD_FAIL은 validated structural failure와 구분 — v3.5 Stage 2 transition trigger 포함 여부 Q-Lead arbitration 필요.
